content:
We have a target molecule: a vinyl group attached to aromatic ring and a bicyclic fluorinated tertiary carbon with OH. The SMILES includes stereochemistry and fluorines. Need retrosynthesis route with leaves commercially available, total price <= $250, and only 1 step (i.e., single reaction). So we need to find a template that directly converts readily available precursors to target in one step.

We have one template from search: reaction_id 604575, retro_smarts_template etc. It seems to be a transformation that forms a C-C double bond (maybe a Wittig or similar) and breaks an aryl halide? The template appears to involve I-CH3 (iodomethane) and O=C... etc. Not sure.

We need to check if this template matches our target. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching.
